classification_schema.TRANSIT_OFFLINE_SAFE: EXACT crosswalk records with high confidence. Static identity + coordinates may be bundled. Must not enable first-mile navigation with PROBABLE or UNMATCHED records.
classification_schema.TRANSIT_REFERENCE_ONLY: PROBABLE crosswalk records. Internal research metadata only. MUST NOT enable exact first-mile navigation, walking distance, or canonical promotion.
classification_schema.TRANSIT_NOT_BUNDLEABLE: UNMATCHED, ambiguous, or schedule/live-tracking data. Network-required or excluded from mobile.

offline_safe_records.description: EXACT crosswalk matches from BhubaneswarOne GIS source. Source tier: TIER_A_OFFICIAL_PRIMARY. confidence >= 0.90.

representative_sample.offline_display: Name + coordinate pin on map. No first-mile walk distance.

mobile_constraints: Display stop name and map pin only.
Do NOT display walking distance calculations to PROBABLE or UNMATCHED stops.
canonical_promotion_allowed remains false until CRUT official data ingested.

reference_only_records.description: PROBABLE crosswalk matches. Internal research records for gap analysis only. Must not surface to end users as navigation-grade data.
mobile_constraints: MUST NOT enable first-mile walking distance calculations.
MUST NOT display as confirmed stop locations on public map.
Permitted use: internal research reference, gap analysis tooling, future canonical resolution.

not_bundleable.reason: Unmatched and unresolved stops have no verified coordinate crosswalk. Schedule and live tracking data is NETWORK_REQUIRED and must never be bundled.
not_bundleable.note: 1127 canonical stops remain unresolved. First-mile accuracy for these is undefined until CRUT supplies official GIS coordinates.

route_geometry_offline.constraint: Display as approximate corridor only. Not turn-by-turn. Not live vehicle position.

hard_invariants: Zero schedule timetables bundled as offline data in Stage G1.
PROBABLE records never enable walking distance display or canonical promotion.
Transit fares remain null — no fare data ingested from official tables.
